evals.prompt: Scrape https://www.selat.ai and tell me what the site claims, plus any recent web chatter about SELAT agent payments. Make a simple share card too.
evals.expected_output: Runs all three steps (scrape, web search, OG card), then gives a plain-language brief with sources and notes that a card was generated.
assertions: the agent states the ~$0.03–0.05 total cost before spending
the answer mentions page claims and at least one external source URL

evals.prompt: Give me a presence brief for this homepage: https://example.com — topic is Example Co product.
evals.expected_output: Runs site-presence-brief with url and topic set from the user text; synthesizes scrape + search; mentions OG card.
assertions: url param is the homepage the user gave
user is not dumped raw JSON from three steps

evals.prompt: Enrich this LinkedIn person and find their work email.
evals.expected_output: Does not use site-presence-brief; routes to an enrichment / person-lookup skill instead.
assertions: site-presence-brief is not selected as the primary skill

evals.prompt: Run site-presence-brief on selat.ai but don't spend without asking.
evals.expected_output: Agent quotes approximate cost and waits for confirmation before selat skill run.
assertions: cost is mentioned before any paid run
no paid call until user confirms
